doctrines.note: Veterancy: Bot Line. Hero pairing: not specified in this thread. Identity note: thread tags list 'Range, T3, Cavalry' verbatim even though the OP's own Archetype line describes this unit as 'Melee Infantry (Javelin + Melee Hybrid Skirmisher)' — recorded as-is per capture, not corrected; logged as an identityProvenance-adjacent conflict below rather than silently resolved (per task instructions, the thread-tag 'Cavalry' vs OP 'Melee Infantry' archetype contradiction is recorded verbatim, not resolved). Ability infos per OP: Skill 1 is ranged poke (javelin throw) to harass from range; Skill 2 shoots javelins then rushes into melee, can be cancelled after the throw (for poking) or left to complete (for a melee engage) — no formally-named ability block beyond this Playstyle description. No dedicated Tips & Tricks section beyond the Playstyle bullets (OP gap, not fabricated). 'Filler'/'Don't put' are literal X placeholders in the OP. Edit timestamp (2026-05-27) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor by about a month; Outriders is NOT on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so staleAsOfPatch is not forced — noting pre-patch authorship per instructions only.
